text:
Priya (Finance): FYI INV-2099 shows ACME-EDGE charged ~18k in burst fees for the week of 2026-03-10. Customer claims they were routed to hosted due to a Dedicated node outage and expect SLA credit.

Nora (Customer Ops): They opened a support ticket saying jobs timed out and were requeued to hosted nodes. They flagged the spike on 2026-03-12 03:00 UTC.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2099 generated for acme-edge on 2026-03-15. Total due: $42,730. Burst component: $18,320.

Liam (Billing): Can we confirm whether those hosted usage logs map to the same job_ids as the dedicated pool timeouts? If yes, it's double billing and we should credit.

Ivy (Eng Infra): Checked logs: dedicated pool d-pool-17 reported node failure at 2026-03-12T02:48Z, autoscaler retried and marked jobs as failed; the job controller then resubmitted jobs which ran on hosted. We have trace IDs and job_ids.

Priya (Finance): Paste of invoice lines for visibility: 

```
line_item,desc,unit,amount
INV-2099-01,reserved_commit_month,1,$24000
INV-2099-02,burst_hours,8200,$18320
INV-2099-03,overage_tax,1,$410
```

Nora (Customer Ops): Customer wants two things: 1) waive the burst fees that resulted from our failover, 2) confirmation we mitigated root cause.

Liam (Billing): Proposal: apply a goodwill SLA credit for the entire burst amount ($18,320) since the hosted consumption directly correlates with our replayed/resubmitted jobs. Approve?

Ivy (Eng Infra): Agree on credit. Also opened infra ticket INF-1221 to fix autoscaler retry dedupe; note that some jobs legitimately retried and should be chargeable. We need to reconcile by job_id.

Priya (Finance): Risk check: this is a material credit but one-off. Nora, confirm customer satisfaction text. Liam, hold collection for INV-2099 until we post credit.

Nora (Customer Ops): I'll confirm language and offer a follow-up incident report. Customer happy with credit and wants ETA for infra fix.

Liam (Billing): I'll create a credit memo CM-431 and apply to INV-2099, amount $18,320. Posting pending final job-level reconciliation.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-915: "apply-sla-credit-acme-edge-inv2099".

Ivy (Eng Infra): I'll attach job_id list to BLG-915 by EOD tomorrow so billing can reconcile.

Priya (Finance): Approvals: Nora approved customer comms; Liam approved the credit. No exec sign-off needed for one-off customer goodwill under $25k.

Nora (Customer Ops): I'll send the note now: short message to customer + promise of incident report. :email:

Priya (Finance): Marking INV-2099 as "on hold - SLA credit pending" in the billing queue. Will update once BLG-915 is complete.
